question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who abstains from any sort of alcoholic drinks
solution:
The correct answer is: **Teetotaller**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Teetotaller"** means a person who abstains from consuming any sort of alcoholic drinks. (शराब न पीने वाला व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite being at a party with plenty of alcohol, John remained a teetotaller and stuck to drinking soda.
 
 
 
• **"Termagant"** refers to a harsh-tempered or overbearing woman. (बदमिजाज औरत)
 
 
• **Example: **The old termagant next door always yells at the children playing in the street.
 
 
 
• **"Veteran"** means a person who has had long experience in a particular field. (अनुभवी व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example: **He is a veteran journalist who has worked with several renowned news agencies.
 
 
 
• **"Samaritan"** refers to a charitable or helpful person. (सहायक व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example: **She played the role of a good Samaritan by helping the stranded travelers find a place to stay.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Teetotaller**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Samaritan** (सहायक व्यक्ति): A charitable or helpful person.
 
 
• **Example:** She played the role of a good Samaritan by helping the stranded travelers find a place to stay.
